problem.name: Google Scholar
problem.description: Free search across scholarly articles, theses, books and citations. A quick way to see what has already been published on your problem.

problem.name: Scopus
problem.description: Elsevier's abstract and citation database. Check research trends and the volume of work on your topic (usually via institutional access).

problem.name: Web of Science
problem.description: Curated citation index across disciplines, useful for scoping a field and finding highly cited work.

problem.name: Google Trends
problem.description: Shows how interest in a topic changes over time and by region, helpful for motivating a problem.

literature.name: Google Scholar
literature.description: Free search across scholarly literature with 'cited by' and 'related articles' links, plus alerts for new papers.

literature.name: Scopus
literature.description: Large abstract and citation database with filters, author profiles and citation analysis (institutional access).

literature.name: Web of Science
literature.description: Citation index for tracing how ideas spread and for systematic searches (institutional access).

literature.name: ScienceDirect

literature.description: Wiley journals, books and reference works.

literature.name: SAGE Journals

literature.name: ProQuest
